references.text: The preceding verse describes that the Nazirite must stay away from wine and strong drink, which is the context for the prohibition in verse 4 against anything coming from the grapevine.
The angel of the Lord instructs Samson's mother not to eat anything unclean, as part of the Nazirite obligations for her son.
Confirmation that the child shall be a Nazirite of God from birth, with associated dietary restrictions.
The angel repeats the prohibition against eating anything coming from the grapevine, including wine and strong drink.
Amos complains that Israel gave wine to the Nazirites to drink, breaking their holy vow of abstinence from wine products.
John the Baptist was not to drink wine or strong drink, reflecting the Nazirite vow of abstinence.
